case.pattern_description: Three high-value online purchases within 20 minutes from a proxy desktop device, inconsistent with the card’s usual low-value in-person usage.

evidence.claim: Three high-value online transactions (456.96, 488.04, 482.12) within 20 minutes
Device is a proxy anonymous desktop
Prior confirmed fraud case AGENT-HHG-006 on same card and device
Other cards share the same device

case.summary: The card C07297-K1, normally used for low-value in-person purchases, was used for three high-value online transactions within a 20-minute window from a proxy desktop device. The customer denied the last transaction. Prior confirmed fraud on the same card/device (AGENT-HHG-006) shows the same pattern of card-not-present fraud. Multiple cards share this device, indicating broader abuse. Evidence strongly supports fraud.

final.reason: R6: Same device across multiple cards
R2: confirmed or suspected unauthorized use

next_best_actions.what_changed: Added case creation, filed SAR, and began monitoring connected cards after initial block.

sar.reason: Exposure $1427.12 exceeds $1000 threshold per policy R2
sar.narrative: Multiple high-value online purchases from a proxy desktop device on a card normally used for in-person transactions, with prior confirmed fraud on the same card/device.

stop_reason: Fraud probability >=0.85 with multiple supporting evidences
